pages.text: A metal that may never touch a crucible, a mould or the air. The $(item)Mirror Matter Foundry$() is a stack of Penning traps: the anti-ore floats, melts, refines and cools in fields alone.

Cooled by $(fluid)Liquid Antihelium$(), it casts $(item)Anti-Iron$() and $(item)Anti-Gold$(), etches $(item)Mirror Processors$() from antisilicon, and binds matter and antimatter grain by grain into the $(item)Mirror Alloy$().
Anti-iron, refined in levitation. Its surface never touches the mould.$(br2)Made in $(item)Mirror Matter Foundry$().
Anti-gold: as soft, as dense and as noble as gold. Do not wear it.$(br2)Made in $(item)Mirror Matter Foundry$().
Matter and antimatter in alternating grains, a Penning field between every pair. It hums.$(br2)Made in $(item)Mirror Matter Foundry$().
Antisilicon logic on an anticarbon die: it computes with positrons.$(br2)Made in $(item)Mirror Matter Foundry$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Anti-Iron Ingot$(): Mirror Alloy Ingot$(li)$(item)Anti-Gold Ingot$(): Baryogenesis Seed$(li)$(item)Mirror Alloy Ingot$(): Baryogenesis Seed, Dimensional Residue, Hypernova Alloy Ingot, Transcendent Metal Ingot, Transcendent Plasma$(li)$(item)Mirror Processor$(): Baryogenesis Seed, Dimensional Residue, Omega Point
$(fluid)Liquid Antihelium$(). Made in $(item)Mirror Matter Foundry$().$(br)Used for: Anti-Gold Ingot, Anti-Iron Ingot, Baryogenesis Seed, Mirror Alloy Ingot, Mirror Processor.
